title: SoilWatch Moisture Soil Moisture Leaderboard
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=soilwatch:moisture moisture_pct=*
| stats sum(moisture_pct) as total_value, avg(moisture_pct) as avg_value by bed_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks bed values by total and average soil moisture across SoilWatch moisture events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `moisture_pct` values for each SoilWatch moisture event and review total and average soil moisture by bed.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total soil moisture.
grandmaExplanation: It steadily which bed shows the biggest soil moisture numbers in your SoilWatch moisture data.
